gis_source.provider: Purdue University BuildingShapesZip4 ArcGIS FeatureServer, layer 0
gis_source.measurement_method: Projected the exact feature exterior ring with the project local geographic approximation X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274°), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; retained campus coordinates.
gis_source.area_interpretation: Shape__Area is reported in the service-native Web Mercator coordinate space (Esri meters). Its 3358.578 m² divided by the locally projected ground estimate 1943.099 m² is 1.7285, matching the expected Web Mercator areal scale factor 1/cos(latitude)^2 = 1.7257 at 40.4274° within 0.2%. This is projection distortion, not evidence the perimeter is 73% too large. The model uses the feature ring, not Shape__Area as an area target.

gis_vertical_attributes.field_metadata: Layer metadata gives native horizontal WKID 102100/3857 and Shape__Area in Esri meters, but does not define units/semantics for vertical fields. NUM_LEVELS and Extrution are preserved as raw numeric attributes only.
gis_vertical_attributes.model_use: Official biological sciences article and current emergency plan independently support three floors. The emergency plan also mentions penthouse and basement, but the penthouse is not isolated as a separate visible mass in available official exterior photos and has no measured size/location; it is not modeled as a separate block. Extrution=60 is unused.

additional_sources.supports: Building identity and exterior palette/forms visible in the official photo; photo is not georeferenced and does not establish measured dimensions.
Address and description of three occupied floors, penthouse, basement; does not state physical height.

additional_sources.supports: Site/courtyard and roof imagery, entrance-plaza and arrival context; imagery is not survey-controlled.

additional_sources.provider: Purdue University Department of Biological Sciences
additional_sources.supports: Describes the facility as a three-story, 65,690-square-foot building. Supports floor count and identity, not floor-to-floor dimensions or roof height.

Independent identity and approximate footprint corroboration: 96.28% intersection-over-union and 3.72% symmetric difference; 3.603 m boundary Hausdorff using polygon boundary-to-segment distance. Prior 16.27 m point-to-point vertex comparison overstated mismatch because sampling differs. Purdue GIS remains primary campus footprint; no vertices blended.
Identity, location at Harrison Street and Martin Jischke Drive, and official exterior cues: brick, extensive glazing, and pale upper opaque cladding. No door-to-GIS alignment or measured dimensions.

geometry.method: Build the exact 58-vertex Purdue GIS FID 669 exterior ring in campus coordinates using the repository local approximation; create a three-story main envelope with photo-supported facade zones.
geometry.area_uncertainty: The apparent 73% area difference is explained by the service native Web Mercator area field: at campus latitude the expected area inflation factor 1/cos(latitude)^2 is 1.7257, versus observed 1.7285. Purdue FID 669 perimeter is used as the building footprint. Independent OSM outline comparison has IoU 0.9628, 3.72% symmetric difference and 3.603 m boundary Hausdorff when measured boundary-to-segment; the previously reported 16.27 m was vertex-to-vertex and was inflated by different vertex sampling. No survey plan was located.
geometry.height_status: Three stories are supported by Purdue Biological Sciences (2010) and the current emergency plan. 11.4 m is an illustrative 3 x 3.8 m floor-to-floor scaffold, not a measured height. The emergency plan mentions a penthouse and basement, but the penthouse is not clearly separable in official exterior photos and its dimensions/position are unknown; no separate rooftop block is modeled. GIS Extrution=60 is undocumented and unused.
geometry.facade: Red brick lower volume, extensive blue-green multi-story courtyard curtainwall, and broad pale upper opaque panel cladding are directly supported by Purdue's official 2009 exterior photo. GIS re-entrant edges provide schematic courtyard-facing candidates; the photo is not georeferenced, so exact facade-edge registration, panel bay positions, and entry location remain estimates.
geometry.entry_location: No specific door or canopy is modeled. Purdue describes the building near Harrison Street and Martin Jischke Drive and the official photo shows glazed courtyard/entry frontage, but no source georeferences the doorway to the GIS ring.
geometry.roof: Flat cap is a massing placeholder. Emergency plan mentions a penthouse but available official exterior photos do not clearly show a discrete rooftop penthouse volume, and no plan/height dimensions were found; separate penthouse mass omitted.
geometry.interior: Not modeled; no verified floor plan used.
geometry.validation_note: Purdue GIS is the selected campus footprint. OSM remains a separate non-authoritative comparison; no vertices were combined.

osm_gis_validation.comparison_id: HOCK Purdue GIS FID 669 vs OSM way 283274991
osm_gis_validation.method: Transform both independent raw polygon outlines to the repository local approximation; compute shapely 2.2 polygon areas, polygon intersection-over-union, symmetric-difference area and directed boundary-vertex-to-opposite-boundary distances. Do not compare vertex indices because vertex sampling density/order differs (58 vs 28 vertices).
osm_gis_validation.gis_source: Purdue University BuildingShapes FeatureServer FID 669; EPSG:4326 query geometry
osm_gis_validation.osm_source: OpenStreetMap way 283274991 from saved local XML; WGS84
osm_gis_validation.interpretation: The two outlines overlap over 96.28% of their union area; symmetric difference is 3.72%. The earlier 16.27 m maximum came from point-to-point vertex comparison, which overstates disagreement when two polygons sample the same curved boundary at different vertices. Boundary-to-segment comparison yields 3.603 m Hausdorff. Local residual mismatch remains, but this independent OSM snapshot broadly corroborates the official Purdue footprint. Purdue remains selected as primary campus source; no vertices were blended.

gross_floor_area_cross_check.interpretation: The published total area is about 3.14 times the source footprint, broadly consistent with three occupied floors; this corroborates story count only and does not establish exact floor plates, height, or basement/penthouse area.

geometry.source_registration_status: Exact placement/orientation of the facades and exact door location remain unverified. The official Purdue exterior photo has no geospatial metadata. Storrow|Kinsella imagery labels views looking north/south across the courtyard and describes entrance/arrival space, which supports a courtyard-facing glazing zone but does not identify a precise GIS ring edge or doorway. No doorway/canopy is modeled.
geometry.roof_validation_status: A flat top face is present at the estimated main-envelope elevation. No slope, roof silhouette, or discrete penthouse geometry is claimed; the current plan says penthouse exists but available official exterior image does not show a distinct rooftop block.

validation.software_limit: The pre-existing Blender 5.2.45 source is preserved untouched. The bundled Blender 5.2.0 binary exits before running Python with WM_OT_drop_blend_file; rebuild/reopen/render therefore used Blender 4.5.15. Blender 4.5 truncates the long required scene name; collection and asset contract IDs remain intact. See reopen_validation.json.
validation.scene_contract_note: Actual Blender 4.5 ID still truncates; the full expected scene string is preserved in scene custom property and validator records actual-name failure. Do not claim scene-name pass.

geometry_edits: Rebuilt HOCK from the full 58-vertex Purdue GIS FID 669 ring and retained that exact campus footprint; did not mix OSM vertices into the source shell.
Explained the Shape__Area versus local ground area ratio using source metadata and Web Mercator scale distortion; preserved the separate localized OSM edge difference as uncertainty.

Added broad pale opaque upper cladding plus extended multi-story courtyard curtainwall following the official Purdue 2009 photo; facade edge registration remains schematic because photo is not georeferenced.
Removed the unsupported custom doorway/canopy and separate rooftop block. The official plan supports a penthouse exists, but official exterior photos do not clearly isolate its shape/location.
Kept 3-story, 11.4 m total main-envelope height as an illustrative estimate; did not use undocumented GIS Extrution=60.
